Risk name: Purchasing may depart from the approved plan, resulting in unauthorised spending or unreliable procurement forecasts.
Risk description: Purchasing may depart from the approved plan, resulting in unauthorised spending or unreliable procurement forecasts.
Control name: Monthly reconciliation of the procurement plan
Control procedure summary: Confirm that the approved plan reflects executed, postponed and cancelled purchasing activity.

Risk name: Changes in a supplier's solvency or legal standing may disrupt service delivery or increase financial exposure.
Risk description: Changes in a supplier's solvency or legal standing may disrupt service delivery or increase financial exposure.
Control procedure summary: Identify material adverse changes in the active supplier population.

Risk name: Incomplete or inaccurate cash entries may cause misstatement or undetected payment irregularities.
Risk description: Incomplete or inaccurate cash entries may cause misstatement or undetected payment irregularities.
Control procedure summary: Agree recorded cash movements and balances to independent bank evidence.

Risk name: Billing interfaces may omit or duplicate revenue transactions.
Risk description: Billing interfaces may omit or duplicate revenue transactions.
Control name: Reconciliation of billing data to the financial ledger

Risk name: Inventory records may diverge between stock and finance systems.
Risk description: Inventory records may diverge between stock and finance systems.
Control name: Reconciliation of warehouse and accounting records

Risk name: Unauthorised adjustments after financial close may compromise reported financial balances.
Risk description: Unauthorised adjustments after financial close may compromise reported financial balances.
